The '''royal auction house''' was a building on [[Zygerria/Legends|Zygerria]] used by the [[Zygerrian Slave Empire/Legends|Zygerrian Slave Empire]] to auction off slaves to the highest bidder.

The 50,000 [[Togruta/Legends|Togrutan]] population of [[Kiros/Legends|Kiros]] was due to go on auction here but was interrupted by [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] and [[Clone Captain/Legends|Clone Captain]] [[CT-7567/Legends|
Rex]].
